title: Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses in Salt Lake City
description: Goldman Sachs' 10,000 Small Businesses program, now in Salt Lake City, helps small businesses create jobs and economic opportunity by providing greater access to business education, financial capital, and business support services.

asr.full_text: Thank you. I'm a very passionate, hardworking person. I got that from my dad. I never went to college, so I love to beat all the naysayers that told me I couldn't do it. I am the President and CEO of Chicago Mini Bus Travel. We are in the service business of transporting people, conferences, sporting events, weddings, bar mitzvahs. Every business started small, but people tend to forget. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program gave me some critical tools to do a better job within a company. Like making sure that we understand our financials better. That your numbers are all there. Practicing your financial pitch to try and get a loan. The future of my business is to be not only a local company, but a national company. I want to be able to leave a legacy not only for my family, but also for the community and all the people around me. The Goldman Sachs Program, here is going to help many small business people be mentored and taught by some of the best out there. This is a great opportunity for the business community to sharpen their skills. And I'm excited about the fact that Goldman Sachs is coming to my state and helping me create an economic expansion. It's good for the public. It's good for Utah. It's good for America. Our guiding principle in this country is equality of opportunity. 10,000 small businesses is a big part of that. Five. This is it! 10,000 small businesses, a big part of that. 5! 4! 3! 2! 1! 2! The part I love about my business is that it fixes lives. You learn from these guys, these are leaders. That's what the martial art stuff means. The school started in my garage, with just martial arts classes. Then the summer camp started, then after school program. The hard part is keeping the business afloat, the marketing recruitment. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 small businesses program has helped us attack our goals the way we need to working on our business instead of in the business. Just by expanding our after school program to a before school program is gonna create more jobs for van drivers, our morning staff personnel, instructors. We show them, if you can make it to Black Belt, there's no limit on what you can do. That's the reason why Access Martial Arts Dojo exists. We exist to change communities. Sensei is graduating from high school. Give him a hand. On the count of three, Access. One, two. Three. Access. Give them a hand. On the count of three, Excess. One, two, three. Crescent! I never feel better about the prospects of the United States than when I hear a small business person describe their business opportunity, their commitment. And when you see that, you begin to be very, very secure that the American dream is secure for another generation. It's not what they think it is. you

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it features a small-business support program focused on education, capital access, business services, and job creation. Speakers describe using the program for financial understanding, loan-pitch practice, business goals, and expansion, while the visuals depict workplace and community activities. The material does not present a required payment, data-submission flow, guaranteed return, or deceptive solicitation for viewers.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content concerns business education, financial skills, mentoring and operational growth, including understanding financials, practicing a loan pitch and working toward business goals.
